about.en: SANTOS is the fan token of Santos Futebol Clube, the Brazilian football club, created in partnership with Binance and launched through Binance Launchpool in 2021. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Smart Chain (contract 0xA64455a4553C9034236734FadDAddbb64aCE4Cc7) with a 30 million supply, giving holders access to club polls, rewards and fan engagement features.
